tools.name: coevera_list_accounts
tools.description: List accounts (companies) in the Coevera space, optionally by name. Returns data and page_info; pass page_info.end_cursor as after for the next page.

tools.name: coevera_get_account
tools.description: Get one account by id, with all its fields.

tools.name: coevera_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people) in the Coevera space, by last name or exact e-mail. Returns data and page_info.

tools.name: coevera_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, with all its fields.

tools.name: coevera_list_leads
tools.description: List leads in the Coevera space, by name, pipeline step or owner. Returns data and page_info.

tools.name: coevera_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead by id, with all its fields.

tools.name: coevera_list_opportunities
tools.description: List opportunities (deals) in the Coevera space, by name, owner and closing date range. Returns data and page_info.

tools.name: coevera_get_opportunity
tools.description: Get one opportunity by id, with all its fields.

tools.name: coevera_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in the Coevera space, by status, owner or due date. Status: 1 NotStarted, 2 InProgress, 3 Waiting, 4 Completed, 5 Deferred.

tools.name: coevera_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the sales pipelines of the Coevera space, optionally by name. Use their ids with coevera_list_steps.

tools.name: coevera_list_steps
tools.description: List the steps of a pipeline, in their sort order. Step ids are used by opportunities and leads.

tools.name: coevera_list_clients
tools.description: List the users (clients) of the Coevera space, optionally by name. Their ids are the owner_id of records and tasks.

tools.name: coevera_create_lead
tools.description: Create a lead. Needs a name and an owner_id (a user id from coevera_list_clients) or a unit_id. Creates one record; nothing else changes.

tools.name: coevera_update_lead
tools.description: Change a lead: its name, description, step or owner. Send only the fields to change. Pass the revision from get_lead when the lead may have changed.

tools.name: coevera_create_task
tools.description: Create a task. Needs a subject; the owner, due date, priority and status are optional. Creates one record.

tools.name: coevera_update_task
tools.description: Change a task: its subject, status, due date, priority, owner or description. Send only the fields to change.

tools.name: coevera_create_note
tools.description: Add a note to an account, a contact or a lead/opportunity. Needs the note text and the author's owner_id. Creates one record.
